title: Unknown airline / partial data
note: Operator-code badge; missing altitude and type stay unknown.
caption: Unknown values stay explicit

title: No callsign / zero speed
note: Hex identity is usable; received zero is displayed as zero.
caption: Unknown values stay explicit

title: Aircraft on the ground
note: Ground is a state, never coerced into an altitude of zero.
caption: ALT GROUND / GS 0KT

title: Route unavailable
note: Ordinary ADS-B does not include the itinerary. Do not invent it.
caption: Unknown values stay explicit

title: Departure inferred
note: A question mark and explicit source label distinguish an inference.
caption: Unknown values stay explicit

title: Airspeed / vertical rate absent
note: GS is not substituted for IAS/TAS; missing readings remain unknown.
caption: Unknown values stay explicit

title: Aircraft + telemetry
note: Recommended default: registration/type, altitude, and ground speed replace an unavailable route.
caption: Light aircraft / no route required

title: Registration + model
note: Optional identity page: show the registration and locally known aircraft model, without naming an airline or guessing an airport.
caption: N123AB / Cessna 172

title: Nearby distance + track
note: Optional position page: horizontal distance from the confirmed receiver/home location and decoded ground track. Neither identifies departure.
caption: Fresh position / local telemetry

title: Departure unavailable
note: Optional explicit treatment: FROM UNKNOWN with the aircraft identity and useful altitude, instead of an empty airport route.
caption: Missing departure is a normal flight state

title: Business jet + telemetry
note: The same recommended layout works for a private jet. Use a neutral aircraft icon when no operating airline is known.
caption: N456CJ / Citation CJ3

title: Known destination only
note: Keep a separately sourced destination while leaving departure unknown. This example has a manual destination and retains the known airline logo.
caption: Unknown departure / manually supplied destination

title: Unidentified aircraft
note: A received hex address and telemetry remain useful when callsign, registration, type, operator, and departure are all unknown.
caption: HEX AD56EF / no guessed identity

title: Starting
note: Before a usable feed is available. Do not imply that an empty receiver is still loading.
caption: Status replaces stale flight data

title: Setup
note: Provisioning concept: Wi-Fi and Pi address/port. BLE implementation remains separate work.
caption: Status replaces stale flight data

title: Wifi Lost
note: ESP32 disconnected from Wi-Fi. Replace the flight card and retry using bounded backoff.
caption: Status replaces stale flight data

title: Pi Unavailable
note: Wi-Fi is connected, but the configured Pi service cannot be reached or its response is unusable.
caption: Status replaces stale flight data

title: Receiver Stale
note: Pi is reachable, but the receiver snapshot is missing, invalid, or too old. Clear previous flight data.
caption: Status replaces stale flight data

title: No Aircraft
note: Fresh, healthy receiver with zero eligible nearby aircraft. This is a normal state.
caption: Status replaces stale flight data
